summary: Bing Image Creator offers free AI image generation to eligible users with a personal Microsoft account, with 15 fast creations per day and standard-speed generation afterwards. Work/school Microsoft Entra IDs are unsupported. The official FAQ excludes Russia and China; feature availability also varies by device, market and browser.
claim_steps: Check regional availability: the official FAQ excludes Russia and China.
Visit bing.com/create or the Bing Image Creator feature page.
Sign in with a personal Microsoft account (work/school Entra accounts are not supported).
Enter a prompt and press Create; each generation uses one of your daily creations.
Return daily - the 15 fast creations replenish every day.

social_proof.title: Bing Image Creator | Microsoft Bing
social_proof.text: When you've used up your 15 free fast creations per day on Bing Image Creator, you'll be switched to Bing Image Creator's standard creation speed automatically.

social_proof.title: Bing Image Creator | Microsoft Bing
social_proof.text: Create visuals with Bing Image Creator, a free AI-powered tool that turns your descriptions into images.
